edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the from address, so the caller directly drives token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
deliver uses _msgSender() as the sender whose reflection balance is burned.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender, so the caller gates ownership restoration.
lock computes _lockTime = now + time, a timestamp dependency controlling ownership.
unlock requires now > _lockTime, a timestamp dependency controlling ownership restoration.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap addLiquidity deadline.
transfer delegates the actual accounting to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the actual accounting to _transfer.
_transfer finalizes by calling _tokenTransfer with the chosen takeFee flag.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract token balance exceeds the threshold.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the other half and the newly received ETH.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded when the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded when the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded when both accounts are excluded.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
addLiquidity approves the router through _approve before adding liquidity.
transfer branches on the special flag to enforce the lottery restriction.
transferFrom branches on the special flag to enforce and assign the lottery restriction.
transfer requires recipient != lottery while special is true.
transferFrom reads and conditionally writes the lottery address.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner transfers.
inSwapAndLiquify guards _transfer from triggering a nested swap-and-liquify.
the lockTheSwap modifier sets inSwapAndLiquify to true during swapAndLiquify.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold compared against the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates whether the swap-and-liquify path is entered.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract of the token-to-ETH swap.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract of the add-liquidity call.
_taxFee is the fee percentage used by calculateTaxFee.
only-owner transferlottery writes the lottery address.
only-owner setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee.
only-owner setLiquidityFeePercent writes _liquidityFee.
only-owner setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount.
only-owner setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
only-owner excludeFromReward writes the _isExcluded mapping.
only-owner includeInReward clears the _isExcluded mapping.
only-owner excludeFromFee sets _isExcludedFromFee to true.
only-owner includeInFee sets _isExcludedFromFee to false.
only-owner LockToken sets special = true, enabling the lottery restriction.
only-owner BurnToken sets special = false, disabling the lottery restriction.
only-owner lock writes _lockTime.
only-owner lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner after checks.
swapTokensForEth performs an external Uniswap router swap call.
addLiquidity forwards ETH in an external Uniswap router call.
the external swap step runs before _tokenTransfer settles balances, so a malicious pair/router can re-enter the transfer accounting.
the ETH-forwarding router call can re-enter the contract through receive()/transfer before balances are finalized.
taxFee parameter is written into _taxFee by setTaxFeePercent.
liquidityFee parameter is written into _liquidityFee by setLiquidityFeePercent.
maxTxPercent parameter is scaled into _maxTxAmount by setMaxTxPercent.
_enabled parameter is written into swapAndLiquifyEnabled by setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
_lottery parameter is written into lottery by transferlottery.
amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer by transfer.
contractTokenBalance local drives the swap-and-liquify decision in _transfer.
time parameter is added to now to produce _lockTime in lock.
account parameter is written into the _isExcludedFromFee mapping.
half local is the swapped portion of the contract token balance.
initialBalance local is captured before the ETH swap to measure received ETH.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter taxFee has no independent behaviour and exists only to write _taxFee inside setTaxFeePercent.
The parameter liquidityFee is only consumed by setLiquidityFeePercent when writing _liquidityFee.
The parameter maxTxPercent is only used to compute _maxTxAmount inside setMaxTxPercent.
The parameter _enabled is only used to toggle swapAndLiquifyEnabled in setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
The parameter _lottery is only assigned to the lottery state variable by transferlottery.
The parameter amount flows directly into _transfer and has no meaning outside transfer.
The local contractTokenBalance is computed and only used to decide on swapAndLiquify within _transfer.
The parameter time is only used to compute _lockTime = now + time inside lock.
The parameter account is only written into the _isExcludedFromFee mapping by excludeFromFee.
The local half is a scratch value within swapAndLiquify and is immediately forwarded to the swap step.
The local initialBalance exists only inside swapAndLiquify to measure newly received ETH.
The parameter tokenAmount is approved and passed into the router swap by swapTokensForEth.
